title: OpenCode command frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of .agents/commands/<name>.md, generated from .claude/commands by sync-agents-mirror.mjs (never edited by hand). The markdown body is the command template. x-maxwell is copied verbatim from the Claude Code command

examples.description: Run every Maxwell validator (layout, schemas, data, frontmatter, workflows, mirror) and report problems by path

description.description: One-line help shown in the OpenCode command palette

agent.description: Agent (key of opencode.json agent or a file in .agents/agents) that executes the command

model.description: Model override in provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5

subtask.description: When true the command runs as a subtask in a fresh context instead of the current session

x-maxwell.description: Maxwell metadata copied from the canonical Claude Code command
